cell_1: 1964--1990 uses the identical fixed schedule in every year. Annual rows through 2025 retain the actual main-data inputs: observed means at ages 3--15+ where available, with model-predicted fills for 2025 ages 13 and 14. The 2026 ages 3--15+ are the selected standalone WtAgeRE predictions.

Ages 1--2 in 2025 and 2026 retain the 2024 input values. Forecast rows 2027--2028 have blank ages 1--2 because that annual model estimates ages 3--15+ only. Blank cells indicate unavailable estimates. Future rows use the selected standalone WtAgeRE fishery forecasts. Projections hold the 2027 forecast fixed for catch and spawning weights. Detailed source records are in the technical appendix.

Mean and CV use the 35 main-input schedules from 1991--2025, including the identified fills and younger-age values retained from the baseline. The fixed early row and all 2026--2028 predictions/forecasts are excluded. CV = sample SD / mean, expressed as percent; it describes variation in the weight schedules among years.
